$comment: Source trust (V3-ARCHITECTURE 3.4a, V3-DATA-MODEL 2.19.2). An ordered list of evidence MECHANISMS: position decides who wins a contradiction; trusted = may it decide at all; maxAgeDays = it stops deciding when its evidence is older. A mechanism that is not trusted or too old is still collected and recorded as a claim -- it only cannot change the tier, CMDB values or the score. Applies to enrichment rules now and to risk factors from milestone M7. Customer overrides: trust.custom.json -- a DELTA by id (silence = inherit the shipped entry and its position).

The operator's tier tag on a device (e.g. EmployeeWorkstations--tier2--SI). LAST on purpose (owner: tags must continue to be used, just low prio): its rules are asserted, so it sets the tier only when no observed rule claims one.
